items.titulo: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
items.resumen: Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Meet Facebook’s Your Algorithm: How Meta Turns Plain-Language Preferences Into Ranking
items.resumen: Meta's engineering team explains how Facebook's Your Algorithm turns plain-language interests into ranking signals for Feed and Reels, using LLM validation, 4 retrieval sources, layered filtering and a fine-tuned LLM reranker. The post Meet Facebook’s Your Algorithm: How Meta Turns Plain-Language Preferences Into Ranking appeared first on MarkTechPost .
